Scholarship overview

The Royal College of Art's Net Zero Futures award connects doctoral design research with environmental change. The next call is a funding route to monitor: its closing date has not yet been announced, so earlier recruitment dates should not be treated as the new deadline.

Research Areas

  • Design research
  • Net zero
  • Environmental change

Funding and duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionPhD scholarship / studentship
Stipend / salaryTuition coverage and living stipend; published stipend GBP 23,805/year. The next application deadline is not yet announced.

Eligibility and Requirements

CriterionRequirement
Applicant eligibilityProgramme and project criteria apply; see official eligibility guidance
Further conditionsDesign and net zero research; check new call before preparing an application.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusUpcoming call
Deadline / consideration round2027 call deadline not yet announced
LocationUnited Kingdom

How to Apply

  1. Review the official programme page and check the opening date for the next call.
  2. Use the new call to select a project or research area and identify the documents required for that application route.
  3. Complete the submission when the application window opens, using the new deadline rather than an earlier recruitment cycle.

About Royal College of Art

The Royal College of Art offers postgraduate research in art, design and related disciplines. Its Net Zero Futures doctoral funding connects design research with environmental change and the transition towards lower-carbon systems.
